experimental_design: We used an integrated genomics approach to profile and characterize the cistrome of TRβ, map changes in chromatin accessibility, and capture the transcriptomic changes in response to T3 in normal human thyroid cells.
factor_value: Nthy-ORI cells were harvested after 6 h of treatment with T3 or vehicle control, washed, and bound to activated Concanavalin A coated magnetic beads (Epicypher 21-1401).
number_of_biological_replicates: This was repeated to collect a total of three biological replicates per condition.
technology_type: LC–MS was performed using an LTQ-Orbitrap instrument (ThermoFisher).
